repositories.name: colibri
repositories.description: Run frontier MoE models on hardware you already own — pure C, zero deps, experts streamed from disk. Tiny engine, immense model. 🐦
repositories.summary: Colibrì 是一个纯 C 编写、无依赖的推理引擎，通过将显存、内存和磁盘统一为分层存储，让普通消费级硬件也能运行 744B 至 2.8T 参数的前沿 MoE 大模型。

repositories.name: open-code-review
repositories.description: Fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
repositories.summary: 阿里开源的 AI 代码审查命令行工具，用确定性流程与大模型结合，按行给出评论并内置多语言安全规则。

repositories.name: YuE
repositories.description: YuE2: frontier music generation with symbolic planning, zero-shot covers, and agentic music editing.
repositories.summary: YuE2 是一个 Python 音乐生成项目，可依据歌词与风格生成完整歌曲，并支持翻唱、符号化乐谱规划与智能体编辑。

repositories.name: VoiceStudio
repositories.description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.
repositories.summary: VoiceStudio 是一个完全本地运行的开源语音工具，支持语音克隆、配音、听写、转录和有声书制作，覆盖 646 种语言。

repositories.name: MiroFish
repositories.description: A Simple and Universal Swarm Intelligence Engine, Predicting Anything. 简洁通用的群体智能引擎，预测万物
repositories.summary: MiroFish 是一个基于多智能体技术的通用群体智能预测引擎，可从现实种子信息构建数字世界，模拟智能体交互演化以推演未来走向。

repositories.name: Agent-Reach
repositories.description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.
repositories.summary: Agent Reach 是一个 Python 命令行工具，为 AI Agent 提供读取和搜索网页、Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub 等平台的能力，免费且无需 API 费用。

repositories.name: system_prompts_leaks
repositories.description: Extracted system prompts from Anthropic - Claude Fable 5.1, Opus 5, Claude Design, Claude Code. OpenAI - ChatGPT GPT-6-Astra, Codex. Google - Gemini 3.8 Flash, 3.1 Pro, Antigravity. xAI - Grok, Grok Bot, Cursor, Kimi and more! Updated regularly.
repositories.summary: 收集并整理各大 AI 聊天机器人与编程助手泄露的系统提示词，按厂商分类存档，供查阅研究。

repositories.name: oh-my-hermes
repositories.description: All in one plugin for Hermes Agent ⚚ the coding intelligence, a long-term memory system and model optimized workflow packages
repositories.summary: oh-my-hermes 是 Hermes Agent 的一体化插件，提供编码智能、长期记忆系统和模型优化的工作流包。

repositories.name: localsend
repositories.description: An open-source cross-platform alternative to AirDrop
repositories.summary: LocalSend 是一款开源跨平台文件传输应用，通过本地网络在设备间安全收发文件，无需联网或第三方服务器。

repositories.name: vaultwarden
repositories.description: Unofficial Bitwarden compatible server written in Rust, formerly known as bitwarden_rs
repositories.summary: Vaultwarden 是用 Rust 编写的非官方 Bitwarden 兼容服务器，实现客户端 API，适合资源有限的自托管部署。

repositories.name: TradingAgents
repositories.description: TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework
repositories.summary: TradingAgents 是一个基于大语言模型的多智能体金融交易框架，模拟真实交易公司分工，由分析师、研究员、交易员和风控等角色协作完成股票分析与交易决策。

repositories.name: RuView
repositories.description: π RuView turns commodity WiFi signals into real-time spatial intelligence, vital sign monitoring, and presence detection — all without a single pixel of video.
repositories.summary: RuView 是一个基于 Rust 的 WiFi 感知平台，利用普通路由器的无线电信号实现人员检测、呼吸心率监测和穿墙空间感知，无需摄像头或穿戴设备。

repositories.name: agent-skills
repositories.description: The secure, validated skill registry for professional AI coding agents. Extend Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot and more with absolute confidence.
repositories.summary: 这是一个面向 AI 编程代理的技能注册表与命令行工具，用于浏览、安装和管理经过安全验证的技能包，支持 Cursor、Claude Code 等代理。

repositories.name: VoxCPM
repositories.description: VoxCPM2: Tokenizer-Free TTS for Multilingual Speech Generation, Creative Voice Design, and True-to-Life Cloning
repositories.summary: VoxCPM2 是 OpenBMB 推出的无分词器语音合成模型，支持30种语言、语音设计与可控声音克隆，输出48kHz音频。

repositories.name: transformers
repositories.description: 🤗 Transformers: the model-definition framework for state-of-the-art machine learning models in text, vision, audio, and multimodal models, for both inference and training.

repositories.name: ever-gauzy

repositories.name: project-nomad
repositories.description: Project NOMAD is an offline-first knowledge and education server. Wikipedia, thousands of books, courses, maps, and optional local AI, all running on hardware you own with no internet required.
repositories.summary: Project NOMAD 是一个离线优先的知识与教育服务器，通过 Docker 在自有硬件上提供维基百科、书籍、课程、地图及可选本地 AI 等资源。

repositories.name: flowsint

repositories.name: opendisplay
